description: Elektromobilių įkrovos stotelės is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Via Lietuva. Information on the location, operation and occupancy of charging stations for electric vehicles built near state and local roads, types of connections -. Coverage: Via Lietuva. The portal shows the English title as "Electric vehicle charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Via Lietuva. Its keywords include elektromobilių įkrovos stotelės, elektromobiliai. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
